LanguageData.YR_SamokCoffinAutoHaulDesc: Haulers bring adult abyss-bride corpses to this empty tentacle bed. The body is preserved and the same pawn resurrects after five days. Living occupants prevent corpse storage.
LanguageData.YR_SamokCoffinEjectDesc: Release the corpse safely. This resets resurrection progress and disables automatic hauling to this bed until enabled again.
